translations.translatedText: # Friday 26.4.2019 (radio)

Metsä Group is investing in Kemi and Rauma. Antti Rinne has started the government exploratory talks. The SAS pilots' strike is cancelling flights. The HSL ticket reform takes effect tonight. Actor Tommi Korpela was awarded in Moscow.
## Kemi gets a bioproduct factory
![Metsä Group bioproduct mill.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9934539)
Open image viewer
Metsä Group also has a big bioproduct mill in Äänekoski. Photo: Metsä Group
Forestry company Metsä Group plans to build a new bioproduct factory in Kemi. Metsä Group says that it will invest 1.5 billion euros in the new factory.
The new factory will employ 250 people. The new factory can produce 1.5 million tonnes of pulp and other bioproducts per year.
Metsä Group also plans to build a new sawmill in Rauma. The new sawmill will employ a hundred people.
The final decision to build will be made next summer.
## Government exploratory talks began
![Antti Rinne and Antti Lindtman](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10756734)
Open image viewer
Antti Rinne was chosen as government explorer. Photo: Mauri Ratilainen / AOP
Government negotiations are about to start. SDP chairman Antti Rinne was chosen as government explorer today.

At first Rinne gave the other parties a list of questions. The questions concern, for example, education and climate change. With the questions Rinne wants to find out which parties cooperation might work best with.
Rinne's aim is that the government is put together by the end of May.
## Pilots' strike cancels SAS flights
![Passenger at the airport.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-8952424)
Open image viewer
SAS cancelled more than 600 flights today. Photo: Mikael Fritzon / EPA
The strike at the Nordic airline SAS may continue until Sunday.
About 1,500 SAS pilots in Sweden, Norway and Denmark are on strike. The pilots and the employer are in dispute about pay rises.
Today, Friday, SAS cancelled more than 600 flights because of the strike. SAS says that if the strike continues until Sunday, it will affect the flights of up to 170,000 passengers.
## HSL's ticket pricing changes
![HSL zone model](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10050104)
Open image viewer
In the HSL reform the Helsinki region is divided into 4 zones. Photo: HSL
Ticket prices for public transport in the Helsinki region change tomorrow.
HSL is introducing new price zones. There are 4 new zones. The price of a journey depends on how long the journey is to Helsinki city centre.

Because of the change, HSL's computer systems must be updated. Therefore tomorrow it will not be possible to top up travel cards. In addition, some vending machines and sales points will not be able to sell tickets tomorrow.
On average, over a million trips are made per day on HSL's vehicles.
## Tommi Korpela was awarded in Moscow
![Eero Kaila, played by Tommi Korpela, can't get anything done.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10407719)
Open image viewer
In the film Tyhjiö, Tommi Korpela plays writer Eero Kaila, whose life is in a tangle. Photo: Peter Flinckenberg / Bufo
Actor Tommi Korpela has been awarded at the Moscow International Film Festival. Korpela was awarded the prize for best actor in a leading role.
Korpela received the award for director Aleksi Salmenperä's film Tyhjiö. In the film Korpela plays a writer whose career and relationship are in a tangle.
In Finland the film Tyhjiö won a total of 4 Jussi awards in March. Tyhjiö won, for example, the Jussi for best film of the year.
